# Needle coke market competition increasingly intensive on oversupply

Source: Mysteel May 14, 2024 13:33 

The two major downstream consumption fields of needle coke, graphite electrode and anode material, showed different development trends concerning the demand for needle coke, intensifying competition in the needle coke industry, according to OilChem.

 China's Anode Material Monthly Operating Rates

Source: OilChem

An increase in planned production for anode material boosted the needle coke demand. Thanks to a rally in demand, anode material enterprises nearly ran at full capacity in April. The anode material production stood at 161,700 tonnes in April, with the capacity utilization rate gaining 10.19 percentage points over month to 70.08%, thus pushing up the demand for needle coke. As of May 13, the green needle coke price stood at Yuan 5,139/t, up Yuan 100-200/t from the beginning of the year, OilChem's data showed.

 China's Electric Arc Furnace Steelmaking Operating Rates

Source: OilChem

However, affected by the ongoing downturn in the real estate and steel industries, the demand for graphite electrode was weak, thus affecting the demand for needle coke. Based on OilChem's data, the operating rates of electric arc furnace (EAF) steelmaking plants averaged 64.18% in the week ending May 10, down 0.83 percentage points from last week and 2.48 percentage points from last year.

At present, the oil-based needle coke manufactures arranged the production according to their orderbook, and oil-based needle coke production rose 8.30% over month to 65,300 tonnes in April, including 42,000 tonnes of green needle coke and 26,300 tonnes of calcined needle coke. Coal-based needle coke enterprises mostly changed or stopped the production.
